title: Rock Elm: Ancient Rock Elms You Can Visit
meta_description: A North American elm rare in cultivation. In St. Louis, Tower Grove Park injects its 30.5-metre rock elm every three years against Dutch elm disease.
intro: The rock elm is a North American elm, rare in cultivation and hit by the same Dutch elm disease that stripped the American elm from so many streets. Quebec listed it as threatened in 2005. Those on this page are all planted park trees.In St. Louis, Tower Grove Park injects its tallest rock elm every three years against the disease, and in the park's own words it would otherwise face certain death. Boston's Public Garden holds the only rock elm among roughly 1,500 recorded trees in its three central parks, near the tool shed. Tacoma's in Wright Park, on the city's Heritage Tree register, went in somewhere between the late 1800s and the early 1900s. Ottawa's, at the Dominion Arboretum, is a nursery form planted about half a century ago, a chance to see one of only three elms native to Canada.
